messages:
lydia: Heads-up: We're opening a soft-launch reservation window for A100X-80GB dedicated pools in eu-north-1 (2 AZs) and expanding eu-central-1 with an extra AZ. Reservations go live in the Console at 17:00 UTC and via the Reservations API now (read-only until 17:00 for preview). Docs: https://redwood.internal/dedicated/a100x-prelaunch

ryan: Nice. Any limits customers should know about for the soft-launch?

lydia: Yes 1: initial inventory is constrained. We'll accept reservations but are imposing a temporary per-customer reservation limit of 3 racks until 2026-05-01 to avoid single-tenant hoarding. Also, cross-AZ pinning is available for high-availability configs (extra cost).

marta: For teams doing live migrations: what's the expected perf delta if routed to fallback capacity?

lydia: Fallback options include L40s and H100 shared pools. Expect around 10-30% difference depending on model and sequence length; larger contexts skew higher. Customers will be notified when their reserved fleet finishes provisioning and when fallbacks are active.

infra-bot: Capacity-alloc created: dedicated:a100x:eu-north-1 (cap-17906). Templates pushed: reserved-a100x-ha, reserved-a100x-default.

finance: Billing note 1: reservations created during soft-launch will be prorated to the provisioning date. If customers switch to HA cross-AZ, there is an extra monthly surcharge per rack; details in billing doc.

support_lead: We're scheduling two office hours next week for migration walkthroughs (one APAC-friendly, one EMEA). Solutions will offer consults for enterprise accounts that reserve >=2 racks. Invite goes out tomorrow.

ryan: How do customers opt into cross-AZ? API only or console flag too?

lydia: Both. Console checkbox or via API by adding "availability_zones": ["az-a", "az-b"] in the reservation payload. Quick sample in the doc (see "HA reservation example").

lydia: TL;DR: soft-launch A100X-80GB in eu-north-1 + extra AZ in eu-central-1, reservations open 17:00 UTC, per-customer limit=3 racks until 2026-05-01, HA cross-AZ available (surcharge), fallbacks to L40/H100 with perf variance, prorated billing for early reservations, office hours + consults available. Ping @support_lead or reply here for questions. :rocket:
